Job Summary

Accenture is looking for bright and enthusiastic Custom Software Engineers to join their team in Hyderabad as Packaged Application Development Associates. This off-campus opportunity is ideal for freshers and recent graduates from the 2024, 2025, and 2026 batches, with 0-2 years of experience. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing custom software solutions, utilizing modern frameworks and agile methodologies to create scalable and high-performing applications tailored to diverse business requirements. If you have a passion for technology and a strong foundation in programming, particularly Python, this is an excellent chance to build a rewarding career with a global leader.

Overview

Accenture stands as a global professional services company, delivering unparalleled expertise and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology, and operations. With a presence in over 120 countries and a workforce exceeding 700,000, Accenture is at the forefront of innovation, helping clients navigate their digital transformations and achieve their strategic objectives. Joining Accenture means becoming part of a diverse and inclusive culture that fosters continuous learning, encourages creativity, and values individual growth. The company is committed to making a tangible impact on its clients, people, and communities.

This specific opportunity targets aspiring Custom Software Engineers for the Packaged Application Development Associate role. This position is critical for developing and enhancing custom software components across various systems and applications. Successful candidates will leverage cutting-edge technologies, modern frameworks, and agile practices to design, code, and implement solutions that are not only high-performing but also scalable and precisely aligned with specific business needs. It’s an ideal entry point for individuals who are eager to apply their academic knowledge in a real-world, dynamic environment, contributing to projects that shape the future of diverse industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and enhance custom software solutions and components for various applications and systems.
  • Utilize modern programming languages, frameworks, and development methodologies (e.g., Agile, DevOps).
  • Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and maintainable code.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, architects, and quality assurance engineers.
  • Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues, contributing to continuous improvement of applications.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry best practices to drive innovation.
  • Contribute to the creation of technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and performance benchmarks.

Eligibility

Candidates applying for the Custom Software Engineer (Packaged Application Development Associate) role at Accenture should possess a foundational understanding of software development principles. Applicants must have 0-2 years of professional experience, making this an ideal opening for recent graduates. Educational qualifications typically include a Bachelor's degree (B.Tech/BE) or Master's degree (MCA/M.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines. A strong academic record is preferred. Proficiency in Python is a mandatory skill for this position. Applicants from the 2024, 2025, and 2026 batches are specifically encouraged to apply.

Required Skills

  • Python
  • Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Data Structures
  • Algorithms
  • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  • Debugging
  • Problem-solving
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Version Control (e.g., Git)
  • Database Concepts (SQL/NoSQL)
  • Communication Skills

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package that recognizes your skills and contributions.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs for physical and mental well-being.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development through Accenture's extensive training programs.
  • Clear career progression paths and mentorship from industry leaders.
  • Access to cutting-edge technologies and challenging projects that foster innovation.
  • A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.
  • Flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance.
  • Employee assistance programs and various perks.
  • Engagement in impactful work that makes a difference for global clients.
  • Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance.

Selection Process

The selection process for the Custom Software Engineer (Packaged Application Development Associate) role at Accenture typically involves multiple stages designed to assess both technical aptitude and soft skills:

  1. Online Application: Candidates must first submit their applications through the official Accenture careers portal, ensuring all details are accurate and up-to-date.
  2. Online Assessment: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online assessment, which usually includes sections on cognitive ability (numerical, verbal, logical reasoning) and technical skills (coding challenges, pseudo-code analysis, common application development concepts).
  3. Coding Round: For technical roles like this, there may be a dedicated coding round where candidates solve programming problems using their preferred language (with Python being highly relevant for this role).
  4. Technical Interview(s): Candidates who clear the online assessment will undergo one or more technical interviews. These interviews will delve into your understanding of programming concepts, data structures, algorithms, problem-solving abilities, and knowledge of required skills like Python. You may also be asked about your project experience and approach to software design.
  5. HR Interview: The final stage typically involves an HR interview to assess your communication skills, cultural fit, career aspirations, and overall suitability for Accenture.

How To Apply

Eligible and interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this exciting off-campus opportunity. Click the 'Apply for this job' link provided below to submit your application directly on the official Accenture careers portal.

FAQ

What is the experience required for this role?

This role is designed for freshers and recent graduates, requiring 0-2 years of experience. It's an excellent opportunity to start your career.

Which batches are eligible to apply?

Candidates from the 2024, 2025, and 2026 academic batches are primarily targeted for this off-campus hiring drive.

What are the key technical skills required for this position?

A strong proficiency in Python programming language is explicitly required. Knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, OOP concepts, and general software development principles is also essential.

What kind of projects will a Custom Software Engineer work on at Accenture?

Custom Software Engineers at Accenture work on developing bespoke software solutions, designing, coding, and enhancing components across various systems or applications for diverse clients, utilizing modern frameworks and agile practices.

Is this a remote or in-office position?

The specified location for this role is Hyderabad, Telangana, India. While Accenture embraces flexible work models, the primary base for this position is in Hyderabad.

What educational qualifications are necessary?

Typically, a Bachelor's degree (B.Tech/BE) or Master's degree (MCA/M.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline is preferred.

How can I prepare for the Accenture Custom Software Engineer interview?

Focus on strengthening your Python programming skills, practicing data structures and algorithms, understanding core computer science concepts, and preparing for behavioral questions. Be ready to discuss any personal projects or internships.

What growth opportunities does Accenture offer for this role?

Accenture is known for its robust learning and development programs, offering extensive training, mentorship, and clear career progression paths for its employees, including opportunities to specialize in various technologies or move into leadership roles.
